Looking for a medical treatment that improves recovery through customized local body cooling? Check cTreatment! As a result of extensive scientific research, cTreatment relies on standardized protocols, allowing precise and specific applications for each patient and every injury.

Medical professionals will find in cTreatment an efficient & reliable way to use temperature control in the recovery process, resulting in both physical and mental relief for their patients.
